file.label: Bookkeeping file
file.engineBrowserHint: The books are processed in the browser. Changes stay in this tab until you save to disk or your storage.
file.engineServerHint: The book opens on the server, so the same book is available from another tab or machine. Later opens are faster because the whole file is not downloaded again.
file.engineDialogTitle: Where should the book be opened?
file.createFormHint: This version can only create a limited-company book. Other forms cannot be chosen.
file.createYtunnusInvalid: The business ID format is invalid.
file.createYtunnusPracticeHint: In practice mode the business ID is not checked. If empty, {id} is used.
file.createYearInvalid: The financial year must be longer than one day and at most 18 months.
file.createWasmOnly: A new book can only be created in the browser.
file.storageOptionalHint: Storage is optional and bring-your-own (your Tilari server or Supabase). Tilari does not host books; the file is never sent to a server you did not provide.
file.saveBtnLockerHint: Save to the file in your storage ({name}).
file.saveBtnDiskHint: Save to the file on disk ({name}).
file.saveBtnBrowserHint: Save to the opened file. The browser will first ask you to link the original file.
file.storageServerHint: The file is in your storage: {name}. Save updates the same copy.
file.storageDiskHint: The file is on disk: {name}. Save writes directly to this file.
file.storageBrowserHint: The copy is only in the browser (opened: {name}). Save links a file on disk or saves as a new name.
file.storageSessionHint: The book is in a server session ({name}). Changes are saved to the session; download a copy from the menu if needed.
file.linkOriginalHint: Choose a .kitsas file on disk that Save will write to directly.
file.saveOriginalHint: Writes the changes to the linked file.
file.saveAsHint: Choose a name and location for a new file. Does not mark changes as saved and does not overwrite the original.
file.linkedHint: Linked to a file on disk - you can save directly to the original.
file.copyHint: Changes are only in the browser until you link the original file or save as a new name.
file.noWritableLink: Link the original file from the menu first.
file.linkPermissionDenied: The browser did not grant write access to the file.
file.linkUnsupported: This browser does not support saving directly to a file. Use Save as.
file.kitsasRequired: The file name must end with .kitsas
file.newerThanCopy: The file has changed since you opened it (for example in Kitsas). Save as a new file or reload the file.
file.otherBook: The selected file holds another company's books. Pick the right file.
file.attachmentsMissing: Not all attachments are in this browser yet (download in progress or failed). Wait for it to finish and try again.
file.sessionOtherTab: The book is open in another tab. Continue there or close it first.
file.downloadHint: Download a copy of the .kitsas file. Does not mark changes as saved.
file.saveServerUpdateHint: Updates the same book in your storage (same id). Use when the book was already opened from your storage.
file.saveServerAsHint: Creates a new copy in your storage. Give a different name if a book with the same name already exists.
file.saveServerDuplicate: A book with the same name is already in your storage (id {id}). Save as a new copy anyway?
file.saveServerKeepCopyHint: Saves a new copy in your storage under the same name. The previous copy stays.
file.savedServerKeepCopy: Saved a new copy to your storage. The previous copy was kept.
file.closeBookConfirm: Close the book from the server session?
file.closeBookHint: Closes the book from the server session. Changes are already saved on the server.
file.forgetConfirm: Removes the book from this browser (memory and local copy). The copy in your storage remains. Continue?
file.reloadDiscardConfirm: Unsaved changes in this session will be discarded and the book reloaded from the original file. The browser session copy will be replaced. Continue?
file.reloadUnavailable: Reload is not possible (no linked file and no backup).
file.lockerEmpty: There are no books in this storage.
file.deleteLockerConfirm: Delete {name} from your storage? This cannot be undone.
file.lockerError: The storage could not be reached.
file.lockerByoIntro: Tilari has no cloud account and does not receive your books. Optional storage below is bring-your-own: your Supabase project or a Tilari server you run. Nothing to do with Tilari’s site. The file is never sent to any server you did not provide.
file.lockerHttpHint: URL of a Tilari server you run — this computer, LAN, VPS, NAS, or home server. Example: http://127.0.0.1:8787 or https://books.example.com. Yours — not a Tilari cloud.
file.lockerHttpNeedConnect: Enter the URL of a Tilari server you run.
file.lockerHttpUnreachable: That address could not be reached. Check the URL and that the host allows this site (CORS).
file.lockerNotConfigured: Connect your own storage first (Tilari server or Supabase). Tilari does not host books.
file.noBook: No book is open. Open a bookkeeping file and try again.
file.lockerExistsFailed: Could not check whether the file exists in your storage. Check the connection and try again.
file.lockerDownloadFailed: Downloading from your storage failed. Check the connection and try again.
file.lockerUploadFailed: Uploading to your storage failed. Check the connection and try again.
file.lockerDeleteFailed: Deleting from your storage failed. Check the connection and try again.
file.lockerListFailed: Could not list books in your storage. Check the connection and try again.
file.lockerGcUnsupported: This storage does not support cleaning unused attachments.
file.lockerIdMissing: Could not determine which book to update in your storage. Save as a new copy, or reopen the book from storage.
file.lockerBookNotFound: The book was not found in your storage.
file.lockerDuplicate: A file with this name or id already exists in your storage.
file.lockerDisconnectUnsaved: This book has changes not yet saved to your storage. Disconnecting blocks Save until you reconnect. The browser session copy stays on this device.
file.lockerDisconnectUnsavedHttp: This book is open in a server editing session (not stored in the browser). Disconnecting closes that session. Unsaved changes will be lost unless you save first.
file.lockerMismatch: This book belongs to a different storage connection. Reconnect the original storage to save, or use Save to your storage as… to copy it here.
file.lockerEditHint: Change the settings below, then update. Cancel keeps the current connection.
file.lockerRememberHint: Store the address and keys in this browser until you disconnect or clear site data. Off = this tab only.
file.lockerRememberOff: This tab only (cleared when the tab closes).
file.lockerStoragePathHint: Example: tilari or tilari/book1. Paths after the first segment use a separate attachment pool.
file.lockerEncryptHint: Encrypts book and attachment files in this browser before upload. The storage host only sees ciphertext. You must keep the encryption secret; without it the files cannot be opened. Turning encryption off stores plaintext on the host.
file.lockerNeedConnect: Enter the Project URL, anon key, and encryption secret. Do not use a service_role key.
file.lockerNeedSecret: The encryption secret is missing or too short (at least 8 characters).
file.lockerBadSecret: The encryption secret does not match this locker.
file.lockerSecretHint: Files are encrypted in the browser before upload. The secret stays in this tab; without it the book cannot be opened. Save the generated secret somewhere else.
file.lockerServiceRole: Do not use a service_role key in the browser. Use the anon key.
file.lockerWasmOnly: This storage only works in the browser. Server-side processing is not available.
file.lockerHttpUnsupported: This storage does not support server-side processing. Open the book in this browser.
file.lockerSetupHint: Your private bucket, RLS only for the storage prefix, CORS for this site. By default credentials stay in this tab; enable Remember on this computer to keep them in the browser. This is your Supabase project, not a Tilari service.
file.lockerConflict: The file in your storage has changed since it was opened. Save was not overwritten. Save your changes under a new name (Save to your storage as…).
file.lockerStatusOffHint: Not connected to your own storage (Tilari server or Supabase). Click to connect.
file.largeFile: Large file ({mb} MB). Reports may be slow.
file.dirty: Not saved to a file or your storage (the browser session keeps the changes)
file.savedHint: Changes have been saved to a file or your storage.
file.unsavedConfirm: Changes are saved in the browser session, but not yet to the bookkeeping file or your storage. The session copy stays on this device; changes not saved to the file or storage will not update there. Continue?
file.busySaveWait: Your storage is processing the book…
file.saveCancelBodyNew: Saving was interrupted. You can continue uploading attachments, or cancel the save and delete the incomplete .kitsas file from storage.
file.saveCancelBodyUpdate: Saving was interrupted. You can continue uploading attachments, or cancel the save and restore the previous .kitsas in storage.

storage.title: Browser data
storage.intro: Tilari data in this browser: settings, recently opened books, and the local working copy (OPFS).
storage.quotaUnknown: The browser does not report storage size.
storage.usageExplain: Measured total is the size of the Tilari data listed below. The browser estimate shows all storage for this site: the first figure is space in use, the second is the browser quota. The browser figure can be larger than the measured total because it also includes cache and other storage that Tilari does not list.
storage.clearAllHint: Clear all removes all Tilari data from this browser. You can also delete individual items from the lists above. The working copy of an open book cannot be deleted separately - use Clear all, or close the book and choose Remove from this device. If space is not fully freed, delete site data in the browser settings (cookies and site data).

storage.blobsHint: Content-addressed attachments (SHA-256). They remain after the book is closed so the same book can be opened without downloading again.
storage.clearAllConfirm: Removes all Tilari data from this browser, including unsaved changes and the local working copy. The book in your storage or in a file remains. Continue?

help.title: Help
help.intro: Tilari is local bookkeeping that reads and writes a Kitsas-compatible .kitsas database. It is not a Kitsas Oy product.
help.li1: {start} shows the balance sheet and income statement for the selected financial year.
help.li3: {browse} lists vouchers. {reportsHub} gathers balance-sheet items, the journal, and cost centres.
help.li4: Close desktop Kitsas before writing to the same file from this app.
help.limitations: What is included and what is not (limitations and Tilari additions to Kitsas).
help.discussions: A missing Kitsas feature or a new idea: GitHub Discussions.

deferred.notInVersion: Not in this version. See docs/SCOPE.md.
deferred.salesHint: Sales invoices (type 210) appear in browse as read-only until billing is implemented.

fiscal.title: Financial years
fiscal.locked: The books are locked for this financial year
fiscal.mismatch: The balance sheet does not balance
fiscal.mismatchHelp: The sums of debit and credit postings differ at the end of the financial year.
fiscal.empty: There are no financial years in the books yet.

yearEnd.title: Preparing financial statements {period}
yearEnd.futureWarning: The financial year is still open. Financial statements can be prepared only after all postings for the year have been made.
yearEnd.lockedNote: The books are locked up to this financial year. Changes cannot be made until the lock is released.
yearEnd.confirmedAt: The financial statements were confirmed on {date}.
yearEnd.lockedConfirmedNote: The books are locked and the financial statements confirmed. Unconfirm first, then you can release the lock.
yearEnd.confirmedFrozen: Changes can be made only by unconfirming and releasing the lock.

entries.title: Post all vouchers for the year
entries.help: Make sure every voucher and bank statement that belongs to the financial year has been posted and reconciled.

depreciation.title: Post depreciation
depreciation.help: Tilari calculates declining-balance and straight-line depreciation from the chart of accounts and posts them as a depreciation voucher.

accrual.title: Post year-end accruals
accrual.help: Postings marked for accrual are moved to prepayments or accruals and reversed at the start of the next financial year.

review.title: Review the balance sheet and income statement
review.help: Go through account balances and correct any wrong postings before calculating tax.

reports.title: Review the balance-sheet itemization
reports.help: Check that open balance-sheet items match actual receivables and payables.

tax.title: Calculate and post income tax
tax.help: Tilari calculates taxable profit from account types and stores the calculation on the financial year.

lock.title: Lock the books
lock.help: Locking prevents changing vouchers for the financial year. The lock can be released only while the financial statements are not confirmed.
lock.unlockFailed: The lock could not be released.

notes.title: Prepare the notes to the accounts
notes.help: The notes are prepared from a template and stored in the books.

print.title: Print the financial statements
print.help: The financial statements open in a new tab. Save them as a PDF with the browser print function.

confirm.title: Confirm the financial statements
confirm.help: Mark the financial statements as confirmed once they have been signed. The books must be locked.

depreciation.title: Depreciation calculation
depreciation.empty: No depreciable balance-sheet items were found. Check that the chart of accounts has APM or APT accounts with a depreciation account set.

accrual.title: Year-end accruals
accrual.help: Accruable postings are identified from the posting accrual dates. The posting is reversed automatically on the first day of the next financial year.
accrual.taxReceivable: Negative tax payable {amount} is moved to tax receivable.

tax.title: Calculating income tax
tax.override: Tax amount (if different from the calculated amount)
tax.saveOnlyHint: Stores the calculation on the financial year without a voucher
tax.clearStoredHint: Removes the stored income-tax calculation. A posted voucher must be deleted separately.
tax.bookHint: Posts a 9930 income-tax voucher and stores the calculation
tax.alreadyBookedVoucher: Income tax has already been posted. You can open the voucher or review the calculation below.
tax.alreadyBookedNoVoucher: Income tax has been calculated and stored. Prepaid tax covers the tax, so no voucher was created.
tax.actionsHelp: Save draft keeps the calculation on the financial year. Post voucher creates a 9930 income-tax voucher in the books.
tax.breakdownHalfNote: Half-deductible expenses are taken at 50 % of the tax-deductible amount.
tax.breakdownSkippedNote: These income-statement accounts are not part of the automatic income-tax calculation.
tax.help: Tax is calculated at a 20 percent rate. The calculation is stored on the financial year and attached to the financial statements.

print.popupBlocked: The browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups or download the financial statements as an HTML file.

notes.editElsewhereHelp: Tilari calculates the figures in the notes from the books (equity, headcount, dates). You can edit the text in this editor or in any HTML editor - copy and paste if needed.

accountType.T: Profit or loss for the period

properties.title: Rental objects
properties.lead: Cost centres as rental objects: money invested, cash flow, return, and the price that gets the money back. Figures come from the books; Tilari stores only links and estimates in its own table.
properties.setupBanner: {n} cost centres are waiting for setup.
properties.footnote: * owned less than 12 months, scaled to a year. † no sale costs set (Defaults below). Hover a column header for its explanation; columns can be sorted and resized.

kpi.unrecoveredHint: Money invested that cash flow has not returned yet
kpi.portfolioIrrHint: sold objects actual, others at book value

col.bookValueHint: Acquisition cost on the balance sheet (linked items) on the as-of date
col.t12mHint: Income - costs over the last 12 months (no investments or sales)
col.irrHint: Internal rate of return (IRR) = annual return: the yearly rate at which the holding-time cash flows - purchase, rents, costs and sale - cancel out. It accounts for when money moved, so it is not the total result divided by the acquisition cost. Objects held are sold in the calculation today at the estimate or book value, after sale costs. The total row takes all flows together.
col.breakEvenHint: Selling price (without loan share) that returns all money invested after sale costs
col.valuationHint: Your estimate of the selling price (Edit object → Price estimates)
col.cashTotalHint: Cash flow over the whole holding time
col.purchaseHint: Price, transfer tax and other acquisition costs (refunds deducted)
col.spentHint: Maintenance charges, repairs and other costs while held (and interest if a loan is linked)
col.bookGainHint: Accounting gain or loss: selling price - sale costs - acquisition cost
col.irrSoldHint: Internal rate of return (IRR) over the holding time: the yearly rate at which purchase, rents, costs and sale cancel out. Not the total result divided by the acquisition cost: -20 % over 16 months is about -15 % a year. The total row takes all sold objects' flows together.
col.totalResultHint: Sale + cash flow - acquisition cost in euros; below as a percentage of the acquisition cost (whole holding time, not per year).

defaults.title: Defaults for all objects
defaults.lead: Sale costs (e.g. broker fee and manager's certificate) and target return. An object's own values override these.

field.excluded: Not a rental object (hide from the list)

breakEven.title: Break-even price: the price that returns the money
breakEven.caption: selling price without the housing-company loan share
breakEven.explain: Not yet recovered {unrecovered}. Sale costs {pct} and {fixed} come off the price; at this price every euro put into the object has come back.
breakEven.recovered: The object has already returned the money invested; any price after sale costs is a gain.
breakEven.costsUnset: No sale costs are set, so the figure assumes none. Set them for the object or in the defaults.
breakEven.bookLoss: No accounting loss at a price of at least {price} (book value + sale costs).
breakEven.taxNote: Taxes: when gains and losses are taxed at the same 20 % and a loss can be deducted from other profit, the after-tax break-even is the same figure.
breakEven.debtFree: Debt-free price = selling price + remaining housing-company loan share. Loan-share tracking comes in the next phase.

chart.payback: Not yet recovered at month end

years.title: By fiscal year
years.resultHint: The cost centre's result in the books: every P&L line, accruals and the sale included
years.netHint: Income - costs in the month they belong to: accruals and later corrections included
years.capexHint: Change in acquisition cost. Negative = capital came back, e.g. a transfer-tax refund. The lines are listed below under the item.
years.proceedsHint: Money from the sale after sale costs

eras.title: Acquisition cost (balance-sheet items)
eras.none: No balance-sheet item is linked, so invested money and return cannot be computed.
eras.lead: Changes in acquisition cost per balance-sheet item. A row opens its voucher.

edit.title: Edit: {name}
edit.erasLead: Balance-sheet items holding the acquisition cost (price, transfer tax, fees).
edit.valuationsLead: Your estimate of what the object would sell for now. The latest is used for the IRR.
edit.financingLead: If the object is financed with a loan: lines on the interest accounts, on vouchers that also have a loan-account line, count as the object's cost.
edit.capitalLead: Capital not booked on a linked item (e.g. before the books started). Positive = invested.
edit.deleteConfirm: Delete Tilari's data for this object? The books are not touched.
edit.readOnly: The data was saved by a newer Tilari; this version can only show it.

setup.title: Set up rental objects
setup.lead: Choose which cost centres are rental objects and link their acquisition items and documents. Suggestions come from the books; ★ = suggested. The books are not touched.
setup.centresLead: Untick cost centres that are not rental objects.
setup.erasLead: Share items and the object each belongs to.
setup.docsLead: Leases, rent increases, maintenance-charge notices and other documents.
setup.starLegend: ★ = Tilari's suggestion from the books or the name. A clear suggestion is preselected; otherwise choose yourself. Nothing is saved until you press Save setup.
setup.starLegendEdit: ★ = suggested for this object from the books or the name.
setup.kindLegend: The kind is read from the name: AP, AH or AK = parking space, LH = commercial unit, otherwise an apartment (★ = from the name).
setup.kindsFromNames: Set every kind from its name
setup.rowsOpen: A balance-sheet item or document row opens its voucher; unsaved choices and your place on the page are kept when you come back.

warn.sale_line_split: Voucher {voucher} sold several objects; lines without a cost centre were split by acquisition cost.
warn.sale_carried: Sold on one voucher with {object}, whose cost centre has the sale lines. This object counts as sold within that price: sale price 0 € and its acquisition cost a loss on sale.
warn.no_capital: No acquisition cost linked: return and break-even cannot be computed.
warn.doc_corrupt: The stored data is damaged; saving replaces it.
warn.doc_newer: The data was saved by a newer Tilari.
warn.loan_shared: Loan account {account} is also another object's bank loan, so its interest counts for both. Remove it from one of them.

error.stale: The object was changed elsewhere. Reopen the page.
error.era_linked: The item already belongs to another object.
error.newer_version: The data was saved by a newer Tilari and cannot be changed with this version.

cash.title: Cash flow by year
cash.lead: Income - costs in the month they belong to (accruals and corrections included); no investments or sales.

sold.title: Sold objects ({n})
sold.lead: Figures over the whole holding time: what was bought, what was spent, what the sale brought.

month.title: Entries: {month}
month.openAllocation: The cost centre's entries this month
month.openAllocationHint: The cost centre lists lines by booking date and only those booked on it. Here accruals and corrections count in the month they belong to and bank-loan interest belongs to the object, so the lines can differ.
month.empty: No income or expenses this month.
month.movedHint: A correction that moved the booking to this object. It counts in the month of the booking it corrects; the cost-centre report shows it on its booking date.
month.recountedHint: Booked on {booked}. A correction voucher's notes list this line as left uncorrected because the year is closed; Tilari counts it on {account}. The cost-centre report shows it as booked.
